policy: Curated dataset evidence seeds are acquisition candidates, not automatic benchmark selections. Every candidate must still pass download, SHA256, standardization, length/profile audit, exact-overlap audit and <=40% identity audit against every evaluated model's training references.

datasets.dataset_name: Veltri / DAMP / AMP Scanner v2 original test set
datasets.length_evidence: The full 1,778 + 1,778 dataset has mean length about 34 aa; the exact 10-50 aa fraction must be measured after download.
datasets.deduplication_method: Original publication reports <=40% pairwise sequence identity for the curated dataset; rerun the current benchmark homology gate.
datasets.independence_scope: Not an independent external test for AMP Scanner v2, APIN/APIN-fusion, AMP-BERT, ACEP or any model trained/tuned on the Veltri split. It may be used for other models only after training-overlap audit.
datasets.description: APIN reused the Veltri/DAMP split; APIN benchmarking set is therefore an alias/usage relationship, not a separate dataset.

datasets.independence_scope: The AMPSorter test/benchmark sheets are model-associated and cannot be called independent for AMPSorter without reconstructing their relationship to training. The external-validation sheet is the preferred extraction target, still subject to overlap audit.
datasets.description: Zenodo explicitly documents separate AMPSorter test, benchmarking and external-validation worksheets; the agent must enumerate workbook sheets rather than treating the DOI as one opaque dataset.

datasets.dataset_name: C_AMPs-predict under-50-aa test and benchmark data
datasets.length_evidence: Official repository describes the test data as under 50 aa; minimum length and the exact 10-50 aa fraction must be measured.
datasets.independence_scope: Model-associated data cannot be used as an independent test for C_AMPs-predict. It can nominate short-peptide sequences for other models only after provenance and training-overlap audits.
datasets.description: The repository contains explicit AMP and non-AMP FASTA files, but sample counts, negative construction and split identity must be audited before selection.

datasets.dataset_role: negative-sampling robustness and external benchmark candidate
datasets.length_evidence: Negative sampling strategies include length-matched variants; exact 10-50 aa coverage must be measured on the selected replication.
datasets.deduplication_method: Positive data were split before negative sampling to reduce leakage; rerun exact and <=40% identity audits locally.
datasets.independence_scope: Preferred robustness candidate because it exposes negative-set bias, but independence is model-specific and must be established against training references.
datasets.description: Useful as a stress-test family rather than a single opaque test set; preserves multiple negative-construction scenarios and replications.

datasets.length_evidence: not_reported_in_verified_snapshot; must pass the project 10-50 aa coverage gate after download.
datasets.independence_scope: Not independent for MAPLE and derived partly from iAMPCN/public AMP resources; use for other models only after cross-database label and homology audit.
datasets.description: Adds a naturally imbalanced recent candidate, but its size does not override the length, provenance and leakage gates.
